def solve_hpc_slot_scheduling():
    # Inputs
    resources = {
        "x1": {"job": "J1", "label": "Molecular dynamics simulation", "priority": 4},
        "x2": {"job": "J2", "label": "Neural network training run", "priority": 6},
        "x3": {"job": "J3", "label": "Genome assembly pipeline", "priority": 5},
        "x4": {"job": "J4", "label": "Monte Carlo sampling job", "priority": 3}

        "x1": -28,
        "x2": -30,
        "x3": -29,

        "x1x3": 16,
        "x1x4": 16,
        "x2x3": 16,
        "x2x4": 16,
        "x3x4": 16
    }
    penalty = 8

    qp = QuadraticProgram()

    for variable in resources:
        qp.binary_var(name=variable)

    for variable, priority in resources.items():
        qp.linear_expression.add(full_qubo_linear[variable], qp.var(variable))
    for variable1, variable2 in full_qubo_quadratic.keys():

    qp.linear_constraint.add(penalty * (qp.var(variable) - 1) ** 2 for variable in qp.variables)

    sampler = NealSampler()

        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
